meta.title: Þórdís Pétursdóttir — CV
meta.description: Software Engineer specialising in backend development, cloud infrastructure, and artificial intelligence.

about.heading: About Me
about.body:
Software engineer with a background as a physiotherapist, bringing practical insight into how technology is used in day-to-day work.

Experience in developing and implementing software solutions in collaboration with different stakeholders, with a focus on understanding needs and identifying suitable solutions.

Particularly interested in simplifying complex systems and improving digital solutions to better support real workflows. I enjoy working on projects where informed decisions need to be made about which solutions to choose and how best to implement them.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Backend development for an AI-powered SaaS platform in the pharmaceutical industry, supporting demand forecasting, production planning, and inventory management.

Contributed to the design and development of API services in Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy/Alembic), with a focus on reliability, data quality, and scalability.

Worked in a cloud-based environment using Azure, MSSQL, Docker, and Terraform, supporting data-driven workflows and system integrations. Also contributed to frontend development using Next.js where needed.

Contributed to implementing authentication and access control using PropelAuth to support secure and manageable user access.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Worked on development and maintenance of backend microservices for Controlant's web platform.

Responsible for maintaining and improving services running in AWS, with focus on stability and performance.

Collaborated with other teams to support system integrations and ensure reliable data flow.

jobs.title: Backend Developer — Tech Lead
jobs.description:
Worked in a cross-functional team with clients such as Strætó, Lottó, and Löður.

Contributed to development and implementation of solutions with focus on usability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Collaborated with stakeholders to define requirements and ensure solutions met both technical requirements and user needs.

jobs.title: Consultant and Developer
jobs.description:
Contributed to implementation of RPA solutions to automate manual processes.

Participated in workflow analysis and solution implementation to reduce errors and improve efficiency.

Gained experience in implementing technology in complex environments and collaborating with different stakeholders.

jobs.title: Representative
jobs.company: Ada — Women's Interest Group in IT at University of Iceland
jobs.description: Designed and managed the association's website. Performed various social work with emphasis on supporting women in tech.

jobs.title: Physical Therapist
jobs.description:
Provided rehabilitation for residents at Sunnuhlíð.

Also treated outpatients and individuals in short-term respite care.

jobs.title: Physical Therapist
jobs.description:
Worked at a private physiotherapy clinic in Denmark.

Treated patients with musculoskeletal conditions, led group sessions for individuals with back issues and neck and shoulder pain, and worked with patients with MS.
